outline:
本課程旨在結合理論與實務，深入探究比特幣區塊鏈的核心技術、在傳統金融以及去中心化金融（DeFi）的創新應用。課程分成三大主軸：1.技術基礎：深入解析比特幣的核心技術架構，包括共識機制、加密算法、去中心化網絡等關鍵技術原理；2.金融生態：探討比特幣在傳統金融與去中心化金融中的創新應用，分析其對現有金融體系的潛在衝擊。結合理論與實務，研究區塊鏈技術在跨境支付、實體資產代幣化（Real World Asset Tokenization）等領域的具體應用案例；3.專題實作：通過專題實作模組，學生將運用所學設計並開發基於比特幣區塊鏈或 DeFi 的創新應用，從需求分析、技術設計到實際開發，完成一個具實用價值的專案。專題成果將通過展示與技術審查檢視，並輔以市場分析與報告撰寫，提升學生的實務能力與創新思維。本課程不僅幫助學生掌握比特幣區塊鏈與去中心化金融的理論與技術，還著重於培養解決問題的能力，並為學生在區塊鏈與數位資產領域的職業發展奠定堅實基礎。
This course integrates theory and practice to examine Bitcoin blockchain technology and its applications in traditional finance and decentralized finance (DeFi). It introduces Bitcoin’s core architecture, including consensus mechanisms, cryptography, and decentralized networks, and explores use cases such as cross-border payments and real-world asset tokenization. Through project-based learning, students design and implement Bitcoin- or DeFi-based applications. Assessment includes technical reviews, presentations, and analytical reports, preparing students for careers in blockchain and digital asset ecosystems.

resources:
● 混成學習 (Blended Learning)
課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。
Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
